headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits and 6 RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Chicago Cubs in a high-scoring matchup, securing an 8-6 win. Daulton Varsho led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list. Adley Rutschman, the Baltimore Orioles catcher, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to June 19, 2026. Blake Treinen, the Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Isiah Kiner-Falefa, the Boston Red Sox second baseman, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, due to left forearm inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Jayden Murray has been traded to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded shortstop Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded right-handed pitcher Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded right-handed pitcher Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.
